Subject: Exploring add-on pricing: retention + dashboards

Hi Olga & Jordan,

We're trying to finalize the economics for a platform observability add-on at Ledger. Two quick asks: a) a clear price delta between our current baseline (ingest + generation) and the add-ons for (1) long-term retention (30/90/365 day tiers) and (2) real-time tracing streams with low-sample/high-resolution options; b) model for advanced dashboards (seat-based vs ingestion-based).

High level constraints:
- We need a predictable monthly charge for budgeting (not wildly variable).
- We're open to a pilot with credits if it helps prove ROI.
- Security/compliance is mandatory; we may need a short SOC-2 artifact exchange later.

Can you send a pricing sketch + any SOW template we can review? If helpful, Rajiv (cc'd on this thread) will jump in with volume numbers.

Thanks,
Eleanor Reed
Head of Platform
Ledger Inc.

Hi Eleanor — thanks for the clear ask. High-level sketch below; attaching a pricing sheet and a SOW template for an initial pilot.

Quick summary (headline options):
- Long-term retention (per-GB-month): Tier A (30d): $0.02/GB-mo; Tier B (90d): $0.015/GB-mo; Tier C (365d): $0.008/GB-mo.
- Tracing (streaming ingest + sampling): Basic sampling (1-5%): $0.03/tick; High-res (50-100% hot window, short TTL): $0.09/tick. We can offer hybrid pricing if you keep a 7-day hot window + archive beyond that.
- Advanced dashboards: Option 1: seat-based (per seat/month) — $25/seat-mo for power users; Option 2: consumption (dashboard renders / query volume) — $0.0005 per query.

Pilot concession we can offer:
- 3 months pilot with $25k in observability credits (applies to retention + tracing) + one free dashboard authoring seat for the pilot.
- If you commit to a 12-mo term following pilot with a $250k ARR commit, we can discount retention tiers by 12% and provide 2 waived onboarding days.

SLA/controls notes:
- Data encryption at rest and in transit; customer-managed KMS available for Private deployments.
- Audit logs and sampling controls included; SOC-2 package available on request (I'll route to Security once you confirm).

Attached: pricing_sheet_addons.xlsx (breakdown by tier + example monthly math), SOW_ledger_obs_v1.pdf (pilot SOW draft).

Would love to schedule a 30-min walk through this week — does Friday morning PST work?

Thanks Olga — this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups before we lock a pilot:

1) Pricing math sanity check: our expected monthly compressed archival delta is ~12TB/month after dedupe. The 365d tier number looks promising — can you show an example invoice (monthly run-rate) at our scale?

2) Tracing: our product team wants to keep a 14-day high-resolution rolling window and then archive. Is the hybrid you mentioned (7-day hot window + archive) easily configurable to 14 days, and how does that change the cost?

3) Dashboards: we prefer a consumption model (queries) but need a cost cap safeguard. Is there a way to set a monthly ceiling and receive alerts as we near it?

If you can send the sample invoice and a small change to the SOW that adds the alerting and cost cap clause, we'll push this to procurement.

On availability: Rajiv and I can do Friday 9:30am PST.

—Eleanor
